hidden_import_helpers.name: Icosphere
hidden_import_helpers.reason: non-skinned importer helper; retained in Blend, hidden in render

leg_sole_sets.selection: four named front/back and left/right chains; actual mesh vertices selected by those chains' weights and low sole geometry, never generated bone tails

fore_left.sole_vertex_rule: chain weight sum >=0.05; lowest 10th percentile of rest-geometry Z within that limb component

fore_right.sole_vertex_rule: chain weight sum >=0.05; lowest 10th percentile of rest-geometry Z within that limb component

hind_left.sole_vertex_rule: chain weight sum >=0.05; lowest 10th percentile of rest-geometry Z within that limb component

hind_right.sole_vertex_rule: chain weight sum >=0.05; lowest 10th percentile of rest-geometry Z within that limb component

motion.interpretation: Root travel, whole-cycle foot-point path, and sole-p05 contact/slip are measured independently. Bone tails are not used as foot points.

renders.helper_policy: Generated importer bone-display helper retained under scale parent but hidden in renders; char1 only is shown.

scope: isolated unmodified Walk candidate inspection; no production promotion

uniform_scale.transform: one common parent scales imported mesh, armature and helper objects uniformly; no vertices, joints, weights, animation keys or relative object transforms rewritten
